reviews.text: We loved our inexpensive and relaxing stay here for 2 weeks with my husband 3 years ago. It is a very down-to-earth tropical accommodation with a spacious private room with private pool. We had our own gate, and we walked to the restaurants and the beach every day. Breakfast is tasty and cooked fresh and brought to our room every morning. We will definitely come back.

reviews.textTranslated:
First of all, it's located a 5-minute walk from the beach. Access is via steps, and the sign with the name of the facility is well-hidden. The reception resembles a tailor's shop. The welcome was good, with some information and a variety of breakfast options (see photo). Communication was a bit difficult.
A small pool is located next to the entrance.
Wheelchair access is possible, but only in the two ground-floor rooms, despite a few small steps. Access to the upper floors is via stairs only.
My suite with a private pool, located on the first floor, is spacious and very bright.
Large and comfortable bed, refrigerator, AC with remote control, safe, spacious wardrobe, two bedside tables, two chairs with small tables, kettle with water and coffee, electrical outlets and lights near the bed.
The bathroom is not very large, with a shower with excellent jets, an electrical outlet near the sink, and decent lighting.
Balcony with tables and two chairs and a small private pool.
Contrary to what was stated on the Booking website, the sea is barely visible!
The hotel isn't on the seafront but in a quiet area. Restaurants, shops, and massage parlors are within walking distance.
Breakfast is served poolside. The internet works flawlessly.
reviews.text:
Innanzitto è localizzato a 5 minuti a piedi dalla spiaggia. Accesso tramite scalini e la scritta con il nome dell'infrastruttura ben nascosta. La reception assomiglia ad una sartoria. Accoglienza buona, con alcune informazioni e scelta della colazione, tra svariate proposte (vedi foto). Qualche difficoltà di comunicazione.
Attaccata all'entrata vi é una piccola piscina.
Accesso possibile a persone in sedia a rotelle, ma solo nelle due camere al pianterreno, malgrado qualche piccolo scalino come ostacolo. Accesso ai piani superiori unicamente via scale.
La mia suite con piscina privata, situata al primo piano, è spaziosa e molto luminosa.
Letto grande e comodo, frigorifero, AC con comando, cassaforte, armadio capiente, due comodini, due sedie con tavolini, bollitore con acqua e caffè, prese elettriche e luci vicino al letto.
Il bagno non è molto grande, con una doccia con ottimi getto, presa elettrica vicino al lavandino e discreta illuminazione.
Balcone con tavolini e due sedie e piccola piscina privata .
Rispetto a quanto indicato sul sito Booking con il mare non si vede neanche con il cannocchiale!
L'hotel non è sul mare ma in una zona tranquilla. A pochi passi ristoranti, negozi e saloni massaggi.
La colazione è servita a bordo piscina. Internet funziona senza problemi.

hotelDescription:
Set along Cua Dai Beach, this laid-back resort is 6 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics and 7 km from Hoi An Ancient Town.
 Ranging from rooms and suites to bungalows, the unassuming quarters offer free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and minifridges, plus sitting areas, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some have free-standing tubs, balconies and/or terraces.
 Freebies include breakfast, welcome drinks and local shuttle service. Dining options consist of 3 restaurants and 2 bars. Other amenities include a private beach area, an outdoor pool and a gym, plus a game room and a tennis court. There's also a spa with a sauna, a steam room and a hot tub.

reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic Airbnb experience! The host, Linh, was incredibly welcoming and helpful, arranging ferry tickets and island itineraries. The room was clean and comfortable. reviews.text: 超棒的民宿体验！房东Linh热情周到，帮忙安排船票和岛上行程，房间干净舒适。位置离港口和海滩都近，早餐和肉桂卷超赞，性价比极高，强烈推荐！

reviews.textTranslated: The hotel is located next to the pier, with two great beaches nearby. There are very few people here, so you can really relax here, even though we're already on vacation in Da Nang, but here the vacation feels completely different. The hotel itself isn't exactly fancy or modern, but it's somehow very cozy. I can't even say a bad word about it. Our room was very small, so maybe that's what created the feeling of coziness, but no, the coziness sets in as soon as you step inside. The owner of the hotel and restaurant is a very kind woman and will help you with any questions. On the ground floor, she makes buns that smell so good you know what you want for breakfast the night before—they're simply amazing. It feels like visiting your grandmother in the countryside. I envy anyone who gets to visit this island and this hotel! Don't hesitate to go, you won't regret it!
reviews.text: Отель находится рядом с пирсом. Рядом 2 классных пляжа. Народа очень мало, тут прям отдыхаешь, не смотря что мы и так в отпуске в Дананге, но здесь отдых ощущается совсем по-другому. Сам отель не сказать что какой-то классный или современный, но в нем почему-то очень уютно, даже слова плохого про не скажешь, у нас очень маленький номер, может из-за этого и создается ощущение уюта, но нет, уют наступает сразу как только перешагнешь порог. Хозяйка отеля и ресторана очень добрая женщина, поможет решить любой вопрос. На первом этаже она готовит булочки от запаха которых уже с вечера знаешь чем хочешь завтракать, это просто бомба. Ощущение как будто съездил к бабушке в деревню😁. Завидую тем кто попадёт на этот остров и в этот отель! Езжайте смело, не пожалеете!

reviews.textTranslated: We had a fantastic 3-night stay in the Cham Islands thanks to Hammock Homestay; we had breakfast in the restaurant, which was also very nice. The manager is also very professional; she organized a snorkeling trip for us; you can also rent scooters.

A lovely place to stay on the Cham Island. The homestay is just around the corner from the seafront, and their restaurant is right by the water (the Quảng noodles for breakfast were delicious!!). The room was simple but clean and comfortable, and I slept really well. Linh is a fantastic host, friendly, communicative, and always happy to help. She arranged my speedboat tickets and snorkeling tour, which made everything very easy. I'd  definitely recommend staying here.

reviews.textTranslated: Amazing experience at this homestay. The room was a bit small and the bathroom basic. We were a little rushed, but luckily we were able to book a room at the Hammock. The owner, Chi Linh, then took care of everything! She booked our boat tickets, sent us the location and photos of where to go so we wouldn't waste any time or energy! Once there, she had everything we needed (scooter, snorkeling gear, great restaurant). She's very adaptable, helpful, and available. On the last day, when we didn't know if the boats would be leaving for our return trip, she was incredibly responsive, changing our tickets to make sure we could get back. In short, a lovely person. Thanks again, Chi Linh ❤️
reviews.text: Super expérience dans ce Homestay. La chambre est un peu petite et les sanitaires rudimentaires. On était un peu à l'arrache mais heureusement on a pu réserver une chambre au Hammock. Ensuite, sur place, elle dispose de tout (scooter, matériel de snorkeling, super restaurant). Elle s'adapte et est très serviable et disponible. Le dernier jour, alors qu'on ne savait pas si les bateaux partiraient pour rentrer, elle a été très réactive en nous changeant les billets pour être sûr qu'on puisse rentrer. Bref une personne adorable. Encore merci Chi Linh ❤️

reviews.textTranslated:
This is a wonderful place! We spent two days at the hotel and felt right at home.

Firstly, this is the best hotel on the island; we researched other options, and I can confirm it. The hotel is located on the edge of the beach, in a quiet and clean area. There's a coral reef in the water, and you can rent a mask and snorkel to swim to the neighboring beach.

Secondly, the level of service is simply incredible! First, the owner helped us book boat tickets, and then helped us change our dates when we decided to stay an extra night. The receptionist was a gem. She treated us to fruit, let us use the hotel grounds as if they were her own, and showered us with attention.

Thirdly, the rooms are simply wonderful. We stayed in two different rooms, and both were excellent, very clean, the beds were soft and comfortable. Each room has a panoramic view of the beach and sea. The only drawback I would highlight is the weak air conditioning in one of the rooms. I would recommend checking the coolant. Otherwise, I'm seriously thinking about coming for a longer period.
reviews.text:
Это отличное место! Мы провели в отеле два дня и чувствовали себя как дома.

Во-первых, это лучший отель на острове, мы изучали другие варианты и я могу утверждать. Отель находится на краю пляжа, в тихом и чистом уголке, в воде коралловый риф и можно взять в аренду маску и трубку и сплавать до соседнего пляжа.

Во-вторых, уровень сервиса просто невероятный! Сначала хозяин помог нам забронировать билеты на лодку, а потом помогал нам сменить дату, когда мы решили остаться еще на одну ночь. Администратор — золотая женщина. Она угощала нас фруктами, позволяла использовать территорию отеля как свою собственную и окружила нас вниманием.

В третьих, номера просто замечательные. Мы жили в двух разных комнатах и обе комнаты были отличными, очень чистыми, кровати были мягкими и удобными. Из любого номера открывается панорамный вид на пляж и море. Единственное что я бы подчеркнула — слабый кондиционер в одной из комнат. Я бы рекомендовала проверить обновить охлаждающую жидкость.

В остальном, я всерьез задумалась о том, чтобы приехать на более длительный срок.

A perfect homestay not far from the arriving pier.
The owner is really welcoming and helpful; everything is laid back and easy.

The beach is right outside the front door: it's clean, the water is amazing and you can rent snorkling equipment for the corals at reception.

reviews.textTranslated:
We really liked the hotel; we stayed in both a small room near the cliff and one with a sea view (the pole didn't bother us, hahaha).
The mattresses, pillows, towels, and water pressure were decent 👌 and it was clean! The girls really cleaned everything well after each guest.
The bathroom had shower gel, shampoo, and soap, but no dental kit (we didn't need them; I only use my own, but some might need them).
Special thanks for the fan in each room in addition to the air conditioning; it's brilliant!
There's a free drinking water filter on the ground floor.
Monkeys came to the windows every day, so be sure to close them even when you're in your room!
reviews.text:
Очень понравился отель, успели пожить в и маленьком номере возле скалы, и с видом на море (столб нам не мешал, ахаха).
Нормальные матрасы, подушки, полотенца, напор воды 👌 чисто! Девушки реально все хорошо моют после каждого гостя.
В ванной есть гель для душа, шампунь, мыло, но нет зубных принадлежностей (нам это не нужно, пользуюсь только своим, но некоторым может понадобится).
Отдельное спасибо за вентилятор в каждом номере помимо кондиционера, это гениально!
На первом этаже есть фильтр с питьевой водой бесплатно.
Каждый день приходили обезьяны к окнам, поэтому закрывайте окна, даже когда вы в номере!
